newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway T-bill auction gets 3.51 pct high yield.
newsitem.headline: Norway T-bill auction gets 3.51 pct high yield.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Monday that a two billion crown expansion of treasury bill SS46 produced a highest yield of 3.51 percent with a 57 percent allotment.
The lowest yield at the ordinary auction was 3.47 percent and the weighted average came to 3.49 percent, the bank said.
Total bid volume was 4.22 billion crowns.
The four-month T-bill was issued on January 16 at 12.5 billion crowns of which the central bank reserved 500 million crowns of itself.
SS46 has a nominal interest rate of 3.50 percent and matures on May 20.
